description: Source code for a PyTorch-based object detection model implementing DETR (Detection Transformer) with segmentation capabilities, including classes for backbone wrapping and model initialization, as well as methods for training and inference.

classes.name: MaskedBackbone
classes.description: A wrapper around Detectron2's backbone to provide padding masks for feature maps.

classes.name: Detr
classes.description: Implementation of the DETR object detection model with optional segmentation support, including training and inference methods.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs a forward pass through the model, returning losses during training or detection results during inference.

methods.name: prepare_targets
methods.description: Prepares ground truth targets for training, normalizing boxes and converting masks if segmentation is enabled.

methods.name: inference
methods.description: Generates detection results from model outputs, including bounding boxes, class labels, scores, and masks.

methods.name: preprocess_image
methods.description: Normalizes and batches input images for the model.
